publishedPriorEvidence.limitation: Measurement archives deliberately exclude package caches, database data directories and build binaries. Their deletion does not remove archived measurement evidence, but must not be described as lossless binary retention.

filesystemSnapshot.note: Live snapshot only; concurrent Go toolchain extraction and overlay filesystem accounting can change available space. Cache logical/allocated bytes are not a guarantee of reclaimed filesystem bytes.

Go implementation, exact versions, measurement raw data, source/binary identities, comparison report and this cleanup inventory are durably archived and read back.
Refresh new/changed worktrees and reserve any unpublished edits before removal; do not infer archive coverage solely from clean git status.
All task-owned benchmark and PostgreSQL processes are stopped; never terminate platform PIDs 1, 2 or 5 on the basis of their working directory.
Remove exact registered worktrees using the owning bare repository while it still exists, then remove task-owned bare repos/tool/cache/build/data roots.
Remove old task roots and exact known /tmp paths; process the current task workspace contents last from a safe external cwd, keeping the framework usable.

Save a final cleanup receipt outside the soon-to-be-deleted roots or publish it directly, including actually removed paths, missing paths, retained shared infrastructure and observed free-space change.
